rationale: C14 is a near-complete country-substitution template for the child. Both proclamations quote the same statutory authority, recite receipt of the same kind of satisfactory proof, and use essentially identical operative language suspending tonnage duties for the named country's vessels and cargoes. C02 is similarly close, while C07 contains the same structure but has conspicuous textual errors.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas section 4228 of the Revised Statutes of the United States... provides in part, as follows
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas section 4228 of the Revised Statutes of the United States... provides, in part, as follows
shared_material.explanation: Both begin with the same statutory citation and reproduce substantially the same lengthy authorizing language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: satisfactory proof was received by me from the Government of Korea on October 1, 1952, that no discriminating duties of tonnage or imposts are imposed or levied in the ports of Korea
shared_material.parent_excerpt: satisfactory proof was received by me from the Government of Israel on April 18, 1949 that no discriminating duties of tonnage or imposts are imposed or levied in the ports of Israel
shared_material.explanation: The factual recital is the same drafting unit with only the government, country, and date changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: do hereby declare and proclaim that the foreign discriminating duties of tonnage and imposts within the United States are suspended and discontinued so far as respects the vessels of Korea
shared_material.parent_excerpt: do hereby declare and proclaim that the foreign discriminating duties of tonnage and imposts within the United States are suspended and discontinued so far as respects the vessels of Israel
shared_material.explanation: The operative provision follows the same sequence and wording, adapted to Korea.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the suspension to take effect from October 1, 1952, and to continue so long as the reciprocal exemption... shall be continued, and no longer
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the suspension to take effect from April 18, 1949, and to continue so long as the reciprocal exemption... shall be continued, and no longer
shared_material.explanation: The effective-date and duration machinery is virtually verbatim.
